item.author: invalid@example.com (Bu66as)
item.dc:creator: Bu66as
item.content:encoded:
Hi all,

I back up a handful of laptops to PBS and was never happy with the usual setup of a cron job plus proxmox-backup-client. So I wrote a small desktop client around it and put it on GitHub in case it is useful to someone else.

pbs-desk runs the backup from a systemd timer and shows the state in the tray. It also has a restore window: pick a snapshot, it mounts the archive read-only and opens it in your file manager, so getting a single deleted file back is a few clicks.
